findings: Representation fitting is bound to the campaign split and deterministic fit-train component membership. It reads only full training-sequence features with targets=False and mask=False, then keeps canonical stride-40 rows at or after warmup. The selected 64 fit components are never substituted with validation/evaluation groups.

The raw normalizer is fit-only; dictionary fitting is a fixed-seed 12-epoch, 512-row AdamW recipe. The transform is stored as weights-only-safe tensors with recipe, fit-membership, and split hashes, and is embedded/restored with inference checkpoints.

Representation features append a fixed 256-wide suffix after the unchanged 211-column legacy prefix. The causal EMA resets at each sequence start and is calculated over the full sequence before recurrent chunking. Warm-start projection rows preserve the legacy function by zeroing new weights and using mean 0 / scale 1 for appended slots.

The opt-in logvariance rows append after all existing output rows, so auxiliary and family offsets stay fixed. WMSE consumes only the first two outputs; NLL uses the same 0.9 teacher / 0.1 clipped-label blend and abs(clipped-label) validity weights, with logvariance clipped to [-4,4]. Synthetic 47-row parent warm-start checks preserve every parent output.

Prediction restoration checks the saved 467-wide layout and transform payload. The family export now selects the eight family rows immediately before the optional two trailing logvariance rows; synthetic tests cover both legacy and mean/logvariance layouts.

Strict propensity precision is attached to loaded model provenance and is selected by the default propensity() call used by cache_propensity.py. A synthetic checkpoint reload confirmed that its strict profile rejects float64 inference input without an explicit profile argument.

The cold import ran trainer, propensity, and prediction entrypoints from an isolated source copy, hashed 96 imported wnn modules plus three scripts, and triggered none of the array, parquet, sequence, or checkpoint read sentinels.
limitations: No production data, checkpoint payload, model fit, evaluation, or grader was accessed by this review.
The dictionary is a fixed fit-only component sample rather than an all-training-sequence fit; this review verifies code boundaries, not downstream predictive value.
CLI checks establish target blend settings, but teacher/cache identity must still be bound by the launch provenance before any training run.
The selected synthetic strict-profile test checks precision-profile dispatch; broader propensity fitting and cache integrity tests remain separate from this review.
scope: independent review of fit-only representation data flow, checkpoint/prediction restoration, appended mean/logvariance outputs, and strict propensity precision-profile preservation
